attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster on node1-node3 (RHEL7), loaded it with application data, then added node4 as a fourth member which received the full dataset via SST and accepted writes that replicated back to the original members. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol for all four nodes, one at a time with quorum preserved, verifying changed boot identity and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
